answer_1.quote: Supervised machine translation (MT) utilizes parallel bitext to learn to translate.
datasets: WMT2018 data (News Commentary v13, Europarl v7, Common Crawl, EU Press Release)

answer_2.quote: We use SacreBLEU throughout. We train two language models (LMs)... and calculate the perplexity of translations generated by the supervised and unsupervised MT systems. We propose measuring translation edit rate (TER) over POS tag sequences.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation complements automatic evaluation... We hire 12 professional translators... Human translators assess a translation by how adequately it expresses the meaning of the source sentence... Side-by-side Fluency Raters assess the alternative translations without the source.
answer_4.guideline: Translators rate adequacy on a 0-100 scale and side-by-side fluency/adequacy on a 6-point scale.
